subject: POC next steps & weekly check-in - TelemetryAI
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Anika Rao <anika@telemetryai.com>, Matt Simmons <matt.simmons@telemetryai.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 May 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC next steps & success criteria - TelemetryAI

Hi Anika / Matt — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the 3-week POC we discussed. Please review and let me know if anything should change.

Summary / success criteria:
- Ingest 1 month of telemetry logs (approx. 150GB compressed) and index for retrieval.
- Demo: Redwood-powered retrieval + summarization flow hitting sub-2s per-query P95.
- Accuracy: candidate reranking F1 >= 0.78 (using TelemetryAI test set).
- Security: data stored in customer-only bucket; SSO via SAML + audit logs enabled.

Proposed evaluation plan & timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): contract redline + SSO checklist; dataset upload prep.
- Week 1: trial instance provisioned; initial ingest + smoke tests.
- Week 2: run evaluation prompts, iterate on prompt set and reranker.
- Week 3: final demo + acceptance run; handoff + optional extension.

Ownership / asks:
- TelemetryAI: provide sample dataset (S3 URI or Secure Upload) and the evaluation prompt set by 2026-05-08.
- Redwood: Sean to provision trial instance and coordinate ingest; Neha to share SSO/KMS checklist; Marissa to own commercial touches and weekly cadence.

Attachments: POC_plan_v1.pdf (detailed steps + acceptance tests).

Next steps: Can you confirm the success criteria above and that the 3-week cadence works? Also confirm dataset delivery ETA.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Marissa — this is great and matches what we discussed. A couple of clarifications from our side:
- Success criteria: the F1 target looks good, but would like to add a latency SLA for end-user queries: P95 under 2.5s (we can be flexible if you can show consistent sub-2s for similar workloads).
- Dataset: we'll provide a 20GB representative sample (S3: s3://telemetryai-poc/samples/2026-05-06). We'll upload the full 150GB no later than 2026-05-10 if provisioning is on schedule.
- SSO: we use Okta; can you confirm Redwood supports SAML 2.0 and what scope of attributes you need?

Also, are you ok with a final demo week of May 25-29? Our internal reviewers are available that week.

Matt and I will wait on the SSO checklist and the provisioned endpoint.

Best,
Anika
Head of Data Platform, TelemetryAI
anika@telemetryai.com

- SSO: yes, Redwood supports SAML 2.0. Neha, can you share the SSO attribute checklist (email, firstName, lastName, groups) and any federation notes?
- Timeline: May 25-29 for the final demo works for our team.

Actions assigned: 
- TelemetryAI: upload 20GB sample to s3://telemetryai-poc/samples/2026-05-06 by 2026-05-06; full dataset by 2026-05-10.
- Redwood: Sean to provision trial instance (target 2026-05-04); Neha to send SSO checklist and KMS guidance (ASAP); Priyom to schedule weekly status calls (starting 2026-05-07).

Attached: SOW_draft.docx for legal to start redlines. Marissa will follow up with contract owner separately.

I'll check back with a status update next week.

Thanks,
Marissa
